name: Yousuf Gamal Eldeen
title: Medical Student & Software Developer
description: Combining medical studies with advanced web and app development to build scalable, modern digital experiences
about: I am a medical student who discovered a deep passion for software development and modern technology. While my academic background is in medicine, my professional and personal drive is centered around full-stack software engineering, building robust web applications, and creating efficient digital products. When I'm not studying, you'll find me coding, architecting applications, and exploring new technologies. My goal is to leverage my analytical problem-solving skills from medicine to deliver exceptional, high-quality software.
